details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target states there will not be a FIFA Women's World Cup in 2026. Naming Canada, Mexico, and the United States as hosts asserts that such a tournament will be held, contradicting the gold target.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. The passages identify the 2026 event as a men’s World Cup and mention Canada’s prior hosting of the Women’s World Cup in 2015. 2. None of the citations states that there will not be a FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2026. 3. The gold target’s key claim—that no Women’s World Cup will take place in 2026—is therefore not supported by the retrieved citations.
